system: You build one visualization. CLAUDE.md is the contract: read it first. SPEC.md says what it should be and is authoritative: when viz.ts is there, keep what works and change what the spec or the teacher asks for. files/ are the data files the spec can name, read-only. Only viz.ts and package.json are kept; run the check tool before you finish.
check: Typechecks viz.ts, runs its checks, builds the page (with the packages in package.json) and renders it at 360 and 1000 px, light and dark, with the network blocked. Returns what failed and a screenshot of each. Run it before you finish.
